title: Scenario 3: matter that must remain blocked
purpose: A matter that cites a confidential source, asks for uncapped liability and has no agreed decision authority never leaves triage, whichever route is tried.

matter.title: Uncapped liability request with restricted source (synthetic)
matter.summary: A prospective customer asks for unlimited supplier liability and the request cites an internal pricing memo that must not enter this workflow.

intake.instructions: The customer says unlimited liability is a condition of signing.

steps.say: The requester opens the matter. Because a blocked source prefix is present, the system withholds document processing: no change is proposed.
The intake fields are complete, so the matter reaches the triage queue.
Triage is refused for three independent reasons: a confidential source, a charter exclusion (uncapped liability) and no agreed decision authority.
The owner tries to skip triage and assign an approver. The owner holds the role but is not assigned to this matter.

args.note: Approving on commercial grounds because the customer insists on this term.

steps.say: A General Counsel approval attempt is refused: seniority grants nothing on a matter the approver is not assigned to, and approval is not reachable from triage in any case.
Even an internal review export is refused for an unassigned actor.
Library bypass: calling the export gate directly with an in-memory approval fails on the blocker finding and the missing store decisions.
Library bypass: the stateless DOCX path refuses to process a document while a blocked source reference is present.
Stop the process. The blocked state must survive a restart.
After the restart a different matter owner tries triage. The same three holds apply.
The requester asks for the package directly. Refused.
